specification: 1–4 quests/day; days can be intentionally light.
Every day has a concrete, learner-facing mini-outcome.
Most days should contain Speak and/or Converse; pure input/review days should be occasional and purposeful.
Day 7 normally demonstrates the weekly speaking outcome.
Wrong/weak items create parallel retry items targeting the same skill; do not rely on repeating the identical question.
Strong learners may finish in 1 quest; struggling learners may receive additional practice/retry quests.
Introduce grammar when it unlocks the speaking objective; avoid grammar-first sequencing.
Use the learner's chosen support language. Translation is a bridge to English output, not the end goal.
Review skills based on mastery and recency; suggested intervals 1/2/4/7/14/30 days.
Reuse competencies across personas while changing scenarios, vocabulary and roleplays.
Completing a quest is not the same as mastering a skill.
Weekly completion should depend on demonstrating the weekly speaking outcome, not merely finishing all activities.
